description: Rules, procedures, and agreements for secure information transfer are not in place.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks controls for transferring information between the organization and external parties, including procedures for electronic transmission, physical transport, and verbal communication of sensitive information.

metadata.detection_notes: Review information transfer policies and procedures, assess encryption requirements for data in transit, verify secure file transfer mechanisms, check agreements with external parties for security requirements, evaluate controls for physical media transport.
